title: Adjacent Possible
equation: Innovation Yield = (Adjacent Steps + Combination Quality + Iteration Speed) ÷ 3
hook: Your next big idea is probably one small step from what you already do.
statement: New ideas grow from right next to what you can already do today.
explainer: Big innovations look obvious in hindsight because they were one step away the whole time. A photo app adds filters and a feed, and suddenly it's a whole new category.
sop: List what your business can already do well.
Find a customer need one step past what you serve now.
Repeat. Each step shows you the next one.
equation_example: Score each 1 to 10. Adjacent Steps 7, Combination Quality 6, Iteration Speed 8. (7 + 6 + 8) ÷ 3 = 7.0. Higher means you're turning what you have into new opportunities. Lower means you're missing nearby moves or testing them too slowly.
question: Name one thing your customers need right after using your product that you could offer next.
closing_statement: The next move is usually closer than it looks.
